input.pr_title: feat: implement content submission with revision workflow
input.pr_description:
Implements content submission and revision workflow for the Creator Campaign Collaboration Platform.

## Changes
- New Content model with 6-state lifecycle (draft → submitted → revision_requested → approved/rejected → published)
- ContentRepository with CRUD + listing by campaign/creator
- ContentService with business logic: create, submit, update, request revision, list
- API endpoints: create content for application, submit, update, request revision, list by campaign/creator
- Pydantic schemas: ContentCreate, ContentUpdate, ContentResponse
- Revision tracking with counter and notes

## Follows existing patterns
- Repository pattern (ApplicationRepository reference)
- Service layer with custom exceptions
- FastAPI router with deps injection

+import enum
+from datetime import datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    DateTime,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Index,
+    Integer,
+    JSON,
+    String,
+    Text,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, SoftDeleteMixin, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class ContentStatus(enum.Enum):
+    DRAFT = "draft"
+    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
+    REVISION_REQUESTED = "revision_requested"
+    APPROVED = "approved"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    PUBLISHED = "published"
+
+
+class Content(Base, TimestampMixin, SoftDeleteMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "contents"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    application_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("applications.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("campaigns.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    creator_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False)
+    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
+    image_urls: Mapped[list | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True)
+    status: Mapped[ContentStatus] = mapped_column(
+        nullable=False, default=ContentStatus.DRAFT
+    )
+    revision_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
+    max_revisions: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=3)
+    revision_notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(1000), nullable=True)
+    submitted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_contents_application_id", "application_id"),
+        Index("ix_contents_campaign_id", "campaign_id"),
+        Index("ix_contents_creator_id", "creator_id"),
+        Index("ix_contents_status", "status"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Content {self.title[:30]} ({self.status.value})>"

+from sqlalchemy import func, select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.content import Content, ContentStatus
+
+
+class ContentRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, content_id: str) -> Content | None:
+        query = select(Content).where(
+            Content.id == content_id, Content.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def get_by_application_id(self, application_id: str) -> Content | None:
+        query = select(Content).where(
+            Content.application_id == application_id, Content.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: ContentStatus | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Content], int]:
+        base = [Content.campaign_id == campaign_id, Content.is_deleted.is_(False)]
+        if status is not None:
+            base.append(Content.status == status)
+
+        count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Content).where(*base)
+        total = (await self.db.execute(count_query)).scalar_one()
+
+        query = (
+            select(Content)
+            .where(*base)
+            .order_by(Content.submitted_at.desc().nullslast())
+            .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+            .limit(page_size)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        contents = list(result.scalars().all())
+        return contents, total
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Content], int]:
+        base = [Content.creator_id == creator_id, Content.is_deleted.is_(False)]
+
+        count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Content).where(*base)
+        total = (await self.db.execute(count_query)).scalar_one()
+
+        query = (
+            select(Content)
+            .where(*base)
+            .order_by(Content.created_at.desc())
+            .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+            .limit(page_size)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        contents = list(result.scalars().all())
+        return contents, total
+
+    async def create(self, content: Content) -> Content:
+        self.db.add(content)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(content)
+        return content
+
+    async def update(self, content: Content) -> Content:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(content)
+        return content

diff --git a/app/services/content_service.py b/app/services/content_service.py

+++ b/app/services/content_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from app.models.application import ApplicationStatus
+from app.models.content import Content, ContentStatus
+from app.models.user import User, UserRole
+from app.repositories.application_repo import ApplicationRepository
+from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
+from app.repositories.content_repo import ContentRepository
+from app.schemas.content import ContentCreate, ContentResponse, ContentUpdate
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.utils.exceptions import ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class ContentService:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        content_repo: ContentRepository,
+        app_repo: ApplicationRepository,
+        campaign_repo: CampaignRepository,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.content_repo = content_repo
+        self.app_repo = app_repo
+        self.campaign_repo = campaign_repo
+
+    async def create_content(
+        self,
+        application_id: str,
+        creator: User,
+        data: ContentCreate,
+    ) -> ContentResponse:
+        if creator.role != UserRole.CREATOR:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only creators can submit content")
+
+        application = await self.app_repo.get_by_id(application_id)
+        if application is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Application", application_id)
+        if application.creator_id != creator.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this application")
+        if application.status != ApplicationStatus.ACCEPTED:
+            raise ValidationError("Application must be accepted before submitting content")
+
+        existing = await self.content_repo.get_by_application_id(application_id)
+        if existing is not None:
+            raise ValidationError("Content already exists for this application")
+
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(application.campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", application.campaign_id)
+
+        now = datetime.now()
+        if campaign.content_deadline <= now:
+            raise ValidationError("Content submission deadline has passed")
+
+        content = Content(
+            application_id=application_id,
+            campaign_id=campaign.id,
+            creator_id=creator.id,
+            title=data.title,
+            body=data.body,
+            image_urls=data.image_urls,
+            status=ContentStatus.DRAFT,
+        )
+        content = await self.content_repo.create(content)
+        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)
+
+    async def submit_content(
+        self, content_id: str, creator: User
+    ) -> ContentResponse:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+        if content.creator_id != creator.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this content")
+        if content.status not in (ContentStatus.DRAFT, ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED):
+            raise ValidationError(
+                f"Cannot submit content in '{content.status.value}' status"
+            )
+
+        content.status = ContentStatus.SUBMITTED
+        content.submitted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        content.version += 1
+        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
+        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)
+
+    async def update_content(
+        self, content_id: str, creator: User, data: ContentUpdate
+    ) -> ContentResponse:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+        if content.creator_id != creator.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this content")
+        if content.status not in (ContentStatus.DRAFT, ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED):
+            raise ValidationError(
+                f"Cannot edit content in '{content.status.value}' status"
+            )
+
+        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        for field, value in update_data.items():
+            setattr(content, field, value)
+
+        content.version += 1
+        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
+        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)
+
+    async def request_revision(
+        self, content_id: str, brand_user: User, notes: str
+    ) -> ContentResponse:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(content.campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", content.campaign_id)
+        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
+        if content.status != ContentStatus.SUBMITTED:
+            raise ValidationError("Can only request revision for submitted content")
+
+        content.status = ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED
+        content.revision_notes = notes
+        content.revision_count += 1
+        content.version += 1
+        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
+        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)
+
+    async def get_content(self, content_id: str) -> ContentResponse:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)
+
+    async def list_campaign_contents(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        brand_user: User,
+        status: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse]:
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", campaign_id)
+        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
+
+        status_enum = ContentStatus(status) if status else None
+        contents, total = await self.content_repo.list_by_campaign(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse](
+            items=[ContentResponse.model_validate(c) for c in contents],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def list_my_contents(
+        self,
+        creator: User,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse]:
+        contents, total = await self.content_repo.list_by_creator(
+            creator_id=creator.id, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse](
+            items=[ContentResponse.model_validate(c) for c in contents],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )

planted_defects.title: Deadline check uses server local time instead of UTC
planted_defects.description: The content submission deadline check in create_content uses `datetime.now()` which returns server local time, while the campaign's content_deadline is stored as timezone-aware UTC datetime. This creates two problems: (1) the comparison between a naive local datetime and a timezone-aware deadline datetime will raise a TypeError in Python, or if the database returns naive datetimes, the comparison uses the server's local timezone which differs from UTC. (2) Depending on the server's timezone, content could be submitted after the actual UTC deadline or be incorrectly rejected before the deadline. Other methods in the same file (submit_content) correctly use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.
planted_defects.root_cause: `datetime.now()` is used instead of `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` for the deadline comparison in create_content, while the campaign deadline is stored with timezone=True.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Change `now = datetime.now()` to `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` to match the timezone-aware deadline stored in the campaign model.

planted_defects.title: No validation on media URLs allows path traversal and SSRF
planted_defects.description: The image_urls field in ContentCreate and ContentUpdate schemas accepts arbitrary strings with no format validation. An attacker can supply path traversal sequences (e.g., `../../etc/passwd`), internal network URLs (e.g., `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`), or file:// protocol URLs. If these URLs are later fetched server-side for processing, thumbnail generation, or CDN upload, this becomes a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) or local file inclusion vulnerability. Even if only stored, displaying unvalidated URLs in the frontend can enable XSS via javascript: URLs.
planted_defects.root_cause: The `image_urls: list[str] | None = None` field has no URL format validation, regex pattern, or protocol whitelist. It accepts any string value.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Add URL validation using Pydantic's AnyHttpUrl or a custom validator that enforces HTTPS-only URLs, validates against an allowlist of CDN domains, and rejects path traversal sequences: `image_urls: list[AnyHttpUrl] | None = None` with additional validation for allowed domains.

planted_defects.title: Missing max revision limit check allows unlimited revisions
planted_defects.description: The request_revision method increments revision_count and changes status to REVISION_REQUESTED, but never checks whether revision_count has reached max_revisions. The Content model defines a max_revisions field (default 3), but it is completely unused. A brand user can request unlimited revisions, which contradicts the business rule implied by the max_revisions field, potentially allowing abuse of creators through endless revision cycles with no contractual protection.
planted_defects.root_cause: The check `if content.revision_count >= content.max_revisions: raise ValidationError(...)` is missing from the request_revision method. The revision_count is incremented but never compared against max_revisions.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Add a guard before modifying the content: `if content.revision_count >= content.max_revisions: raise ValidationError(f"Maximum revision count ({content.max_revisions}) reached")`
